headlines.text: Rewind to 2022, when it was AR Fox's first night in AEW, appearing on Dynamite, rated 7.59 ? a solid showing. Fox teamed with Top Flight in a losing effort to challenge for the Trios Titles, but his effort was strong enough that AEW offered him a contract on the spot after the match.
2024 brought us this moment: Mariah May vs. Anna Jay fought it out in a No DQ match, topping the bill that night on Collision, rated 6.78 with the women's division on full display.

Flash back to 2022, when Jun Akiyama made a statement, debuting in the main event, appearing on Rampage, rated 7.47 ? a solid showing. Making his AEW debut alongside Konosuke Takeshita, the AJPW and NOAH legend pinned Ortiz with an exploder suplex ? fulfilling a dream match Eddie Kingston had been chasing for years.

secondaries.text: 2022 brought us this moment: Hook vs. Lee Moriarty went to battle over the FTW Title, appearing on Rampage, rated 6.78. For Hook, it marked a first real shot at championship gold.
Back on this day in 2022, it was Castagnoli & Danielson's first night in AEW as a team, appearing on Dynamite, rated 7.30 ? a good, competitive contest.
2022 brought us this moment: it was a welcome sight as Lance Archer returned to the ring after just under 2 months away, appearing on Rampage.
